raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner initially misidentified the father of James Douglas, 3rd Earl of Angus as “George Douglas, 2nd Earl of Angus” (a non-existent/incorrect title) instead of William Douglas, 2nd Earl of Angus. This incorrect identification led the WebSurfer to search for the wrong person and caused recurring confusion. The Planner later compounded the issue by suggesting an unsourced “preliminary birthplace” in Angus rather than the correctly attested Tantallon Castle, East Lothian.
